data.overview: The fetched sources predominantly concern "Bliss" (blissworld.com), a US skincare brand with its own cruelty-free claims, rather than "Blissim" (blissim.fr), the French beauty-box retailer. The only Blissim-specific fetched source is its own French storefront, which describes vegan products as containing no animal-derived ingredients. No independent, brand-specific evidence or legal matters for Blissim itself were found in these sources.

claims.claim: Blissim describes its vegan-filtered products as containing no animal-derived ingredients such as dairy, honey, beeswax, lanolin, keratin or animal squalane.
claims.quote: Aucun ingrédient d’origine animale ne s’est glissé dans ces produits. Pas de produit laitier, ni miel, cire d’abeille, lanoline
